preconditions.description: The product of the number of books and the length of each book title must be within the specified limit.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == m for s in strings)
preconditions.description: All book titles must have the same length m.
The number of book titles must match the specified number n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the indices of the book titles sorted in asc-desc-ending order.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= index <= n for index in sorted_indices)
postconditions.description: All output indices must be within the valid range from 1 to n.
The output must contain exactly n indices corresponding to the sorted book titles.
